name: Jumia
product: Pan-African e-commerce marketplace and logistics with major Nigeria operations (NYSE: JMIA).
replicate: Marketplace density, logistics, and loss-funded GMV make this unreplicable for a small builder. Capital and network effects dominate.
licences: CAC; consumer protection; logistics permits; payments via licensed PSPs; NDPR.

name: OPay
product: Super-app payments, agent banking, transfers, and merchant acquiring.
replicate: Agent network, float, and CBN licences are the moat. UI is copyable; distribution and capital are not.
licences: CBN MMO and/or PSSP/PTSP/Super-Agent; NDPR; CAC.

name: Flutterwave
product: Payment gateway and cross-border payment infrastructure for African businesses.
replicate: Gateway tech is buildable; bank integrations, multi-market licences, and trust take years.
licences: CBN PSSP/Switching as applicable; PCI-DSS; NDPR.

name: Andela
product: Remote engineering talent marketplace connecting African engineers to global companies.
replicate: Matching platform buildable; brand, training pipeline, and enterprise sales are hard.

name: Moove
product: Revenue-based vehicle financing for ride-hailing and mobility drivers.
replicate: Needs vehicle capital, OEM/Uber partnerships, and multi-country finance licences. Note: total combines LN247 Aug 2023 cumulative ($335M) plus 2024 disclosed ~$110M; verify overlap before relying.
licences: CBN lending/finance or partner bank; hire-purchase; NAICOM; multi-market lending.

name: Moniepoint (TeamApt)
product: SME banking, POS acquiring, payments, credit, and business tools.
replicate: Agent/POS network and MFB licence are the moat. Software layer is replicable.

name: Interswitch
product: Integrated digital payments, switching, cards, and commerce (Verve, Quickteller).
replicate: Incumbent switch with bank relationships. Extremely hard to displace.
licences: CBN Switching and Processing; PCI-DSS; NDPR.

name: PalmPay
product: Mobile wallet, agent network, merchant payments (Transsion-backed).
replicate: Handset OEM distribution is a unique moat. Press reported further raise talks in 2025; $140M is the firmly disclosed earlier total used here.

name: Lumos Global
replicate: Hardware plus consumer credit plus field ops. Capital intensive.

name: TradeDepot
product: B2B commerce connecting brands to informal retail with credit and logistics.
replicate: Needs working capital and distribution density. Software is doable; float is not.
licences: CAC; CBN finance partner if lending; NDPR.
